claims.statement: The secrets concept declares FPT/GHEC/GHES and two prior redirects; metadata alone does not adopt a secrets policy.
Workflow secrets store sensitive variables at organization, repository or repository-environment scope. These scopes require separate availability and access decisions.
The article requires explicit workflow inclusion to read stored secrets; do not use this statement to deny the distinct built-in github.token credential described by the token concept.

The FPT/GHEC branch describes client-side Libsodium sealed-box encryption before UI/API submission, followed by GitHub decryption for runtime injection. This is not a claim of permanent end-to-end secrecy from the platform.

Organization secrets centralize updates across consuming repositories; repository access can be limited to all, private-only or selected repositories. Shared storage does not justify granting every repository access.
Environment secrets can require reviewers; a job cannot access them until the required approvers grant approval. The article does not assert that every environment already enables this safeguard.
Provide an action secret through its documented input or environment variable; review the action README for expected interfaces rather than assuming a name or implicit transfer.
The source recommends minimal credential permissions, considering deploy keys/service accounts and read-only access where sufficient. Context determines the needed authority.

When generating or using a classic PAT, the source recommends the fewest required scopes; for a fine-grained PAT it recommends minimal permissions and repository access. This conditional advice neither recommends choosing a PAT nor approves credential issuance.

An App can replace a user-tied PAT with fine-grained short-lived tokens and avoid dependence on an employee remaining in the organization; app installation and permission decisions still require review.
Actions masks stored secret values and some recognized sensitive values in logs. Detection coverage is not a certification that arbitrary logs are safe to publish.
Masking is not guaranteed after value transformations, and the runner can redact only secrets used in the current job. Additional protective practices remain necessary.
Secret-use and REST secret endpoints remain follow-up references, without certifying linked content or native deployment.

scope: Pinned full-article reading with literal includes, selected variables and visual dependencies; source claims only, no adoption or live behavior assertion.
